prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: two paper calendar pages; a paper hand.
Opens cold on the ground colour; the first subject enters on the first frame.
Action: The previous chip flips down as two paper calendar pages land on the runway; a paper hand enters and points at the second.
Ends holding on the pointing hand.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "NEXT 2 QUARTERS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "NEXT 2 QUARTERS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Survival depends on capital markets and the next two quarters.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

The scene opens on a flat, unbroken block-color paper ground in vibrant lime green, photographed under soft, consistent room light coming from the upper left. On the first frame, a cream-colored paper chip with a rough white torn edge slides in quickly from the top, landing in the upper third of the frame with a slight overshoot; it features the headline "NEXT 2 QUARTERS" printed in an extra-bold, stable black sans-serif font. Simultaneously, in the lower two-thirds of the frame, two black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of blank calendar pages—completely unmarked with no numbers or text—slide in fast from the left and land side-by-side on the green ground. Each element is a matte printed paper texture and casts a small, soft shadow to the bottom right. [Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera remains in a Static Shot as a third cutout enters: a black-and-white halftone photographic paper hand with rough white torn edges. The hand slides in quickly from the right edge of the frame and points its index finger decisively at the second blank calendar page. The hand holds this position firmly for the remainder of the video. All surfaces remain matte with no glow or bloom, maintaining the look of a physical paper assembly.

overall_soundscape: The audio features the tactile sounds of a physical collage: a crisp, rhythmic paper-slap as the headline and calendar pages land, followed by a dry, sticky sound of adhesive tape being pressed down. These foley effects are layered subtly beneath the narration.
